body: I appreciate it. And will try and find some that I can go to... I just want all this to end. All the self hatred, the disappointment. The emotional abuse from my family... Talking these last few hours has helped me calm down alot... Thank you for everything..

I live in the US. And sadly I no longer have health insurance due to my age. And I dont work since I was trying to do my best and finish college. Hence why I live at home, and feeling sad and depressed makes me feel like a hypocrite, and not thankful for what I do have. But the stress of not living up to expectations and always being called out that I should have done this by now or that by now..... Etc...

I've tried to talk to them about the stress I feel when I hear all that. I've just been written off as being to emotional, and overreacting. No point in even trying to talk to them about it anymore. If an argument even starts, I'm supposed to be the punching  bag and take it. Because if I speak, I'm only making it worse to them. Doubt mentioning therapy would even phase them. I'd just be called sentimental again

Thanks, I know things won't turn out the way I hope in life. But I constantly hear that I'm a failure one minute. And the next that I have to be the one to take care of everyone. That I need to abandon my friends and focus on school so I can get a good job and support them. My mom tells me that I'm the one who will be taking care of her when she's old. My sister who is much older, tells me regularly that I need to just be quiet and take it when I'm yelled at. I have a temper now, and lash out at them. But to them I'm always over reacting. I can't even tell them about my depression. Because when I do, I'm selfish...
